Fans gathered with high expectations, wondering which side would seize the initiative in this tactical battle. Early Dominance and Clinical Finishing The match burst into life in the 18th minute when Eyüpspor earned a penalty. Umut Bozok stepped up to the spot and clinically dispatched the ball to give his side the early lead. This goal shifted the momentum entirely, allowing the home side to dictate the tempo of the game while the visitors struggled to find their rhythm in the face of intense pressure. As the first half progressed, Umut Bozok turned provider. In the 29th minute, he delivered a precise ball to Metehan Altunbas , who made no mistake in doubling the advantage. The pressure from Eyüpspor was relentless, and just before the halftime whistle in the 45th minute, Bozok notched his second assist of the day, setting up Calegari for a third goal that left Çaykur Rizespor reeling heading into the break. Tactical Shifts and the Final Blow Looking to salvage the match, Çaykur Rizespor made a triple substitution at the start of the second half, bringing on Loide Augusto , Halil Dervisoglu , and Modibo Sagnan . While the changes brought some stability to the visitors, they found it difficult to break down a disciplined Eyüpspor defense. The home side managed the clock effectively, making their own tactical adjustments as the match entered its final stages. The definitive moment of the second half arrived in the 88th minute. Emre Akbaba , who had only been on the pitch for a minute after replacing Mateusz Legowski , capitalized on yet another Umut Bozok assist to find the back of the net. This final strike capped off a complete performance, ensuring a resounding result for the hosts as the referee blew the final whistle after four minutes of stoppage time.

On a high-stakes afternoon in the Süper Lig , Kayserispor and Eyüpspor met in a fixture that promised plenty of tactical intrigue and physical intensity. As the sun beat down on May 3, 2026, both sides looked to assert their dominance in a match that would eventually be defined by clinical finishing and strategic mid-game adjustments. Early Breakthrough for the Visitors The match exploded into life almost immediately, catching the home fans off guard. With only four minutes on the clock, Eyüpspor silenced the stadium through a perfectly executed attacking move. Calegari provided a pinpoint delivery into the danger zone, finding Luccas Claro , who rose to the occasion to strike the opening goal . This early breakthrough dictated the tempo of the first half , forcing Kayserispor to chase the game while the visitors sat deep, expertly closing down spaces and denying the home side any clear chance to equalize before the break. Sensing that the game was slipping away, the Kayserispor coaching staff opted for a rare pre-interval change in the 44th minute. German Onugkha was withdrawn to make way for Indrit Tuci , a move designed to provide a different focal point for the attack. The tension was palpable as the first half stretched deep into ten minutes of additional time, but Eyüpspor held their nerve to go into the dressing rooms with their narrow lead intact. Tactical Shifts and the Turning Point The second half began with further evidence of Kayserispor’s intent to turn the tide. Before the whistle blew for the restart, Ramazan Civelek was introduced in place of Stefano Denswil , adding fresh energy to the flanks. The home side played with renewed vigor, moving the ball faster and putting the Eyüpspor backline under sustained pressure for the first time in the contest. This newfound aggression eventually forced the opening they had been searching for. In the 60th minute, the stadium erupted as the tactical gamble from the first half bore fruit. Miguel Cardoso turned provider, carving out a brilliant opportunity for Indrit Tuci . The substitute made no mistake, firing home the equalizing goal to level the score at 1-1. The momentum had shifted entirely, and Kayserispor immediately looked to capitalize, introducing Baran Gezek just a minute later to maintain the high intensity that had brought them back into the football match. A Tense Final Stand As the game entered its final quarter, both managers utilized their full complement of substitutes to influence the outcome. Eyüpspor look to regain control by bringing on Furkan Soyalp , Jerome Onguene , and Talha Ulvan , while Kayserispor introduced Lenny Pintor to keep the visiting defense on their toes. The sports drama continued into the final ten minutes as Talha Sariarslan and Goerkem Saglam entered the fray for Eyüpspor , aiming to snatch a late winner on the counter-attack. Despite seven minutes of stoppage time and several frantic exchanges in the middle of the park, neither side could find the decisive final touch. The referee blew the final whistle at 90+7 minutes, signaling the end of a physical and mentally taxing encounter. While Eyüpspor will rue their inability to protect an early lead, Kayserispor can take heart from a resilient second-half performance that saw their bench players change the course of the afternoon.

The showdown between Fenerbahçe and Eyüpspor served as a compelling test of tactical discipline and resilience for both sides in the Süper Lig . Played on May 17, 2026, the match unfolded as a high-stakes battle where momentum shifted dramatically between two ambitious teams. A strong opening for the visitors Eyüpspor seized the initiative early on, showing clinical precision in the final third. Mateusz Legowski broke the deadlock in the 17th minute following an assist from Umut Bozok . The visitors continued to dictate play and successfully doubled their advantage in the 36th minute, as Metehan Altunbas found the back of the net after connecting with a pass from Bedirhan Ozyurt , leaving Fenerbahçe with a mountain to climb before the break. The second-half storm Returning from the tunnel with renewed vigor, the hosts began their fightback in the 68th minute. Fred struck home after a neat setup from Ismail Yuksek , shifting the energy of the match. The equalizer arrived in the 79th minute through Kerem Akturkoglu , who capitalized on an assist from Oguz Aydin . Just three minutes later, Kerem Akturkoglu struck again—this time assisted by Nelson Semedo —to complete a stunning turnaround that sent the home crowd into a frenzy. Late drama and high tension Just as victory appeared to be within reach for the hosts, Eyüpspor clawed their way back. In the 87th minute, Talha Ulvan found the target following a crucial assist from Dorin Rotariu , bringing the score to 3-3. The closing stages were frantic, characterized by a flurry of late yellow cards issued to Nelson Semedo , Metehan Altunbas , Jayden Oosterwolde , and Luccas Claro as tempers flared in the dying moments of an intense encounter.
